summary: Reference-frame stabilization registers every frame of a hovering-drone video onto one reference frame, keeping object positions comparable. The registration pipelines it relies on are selected on feature-matching benchmarks in which only the camera moves.
takeaways: The registration pipelines it relies on are selected on feature-matching benchmarks in which only the camera moves.
A two-part benchmark measures it and the object masking meant to prevent it.

It measures background alignment, object position error and the share of a moving group's displacement an estimate follows, against a pseudo-ground-truth reference audited with manually annotated ground control points, which also score every candidate.
